vibe_rationale: Twelve-year weekly after-hours institution with a loyal crowd and touring guests, but a narrow, very late-night scene.
fit_notes: Deep community, but the Monday after-hours and long party format sits awkwardly with a health brand, and the adult audience has weak wellness adjacency. Partners are small labels and the venue, with no partnership contact (Linktree and Instagram only). Useful as a scene reference and for after-care or recovery ideas, not a first-wave partner.
